locations: Printed page 1239: sample analysis described by reference to standard protocol; target pressures -33 and -1500 kPa
Tables 1-2: percentage water-content summaries without a mass/volume denominator definition
Tables 3-5: retention regressions; Tables 3-4 on printed page 1242 checked visually

supported_facts: The two target pressures are explicitly reported as -33 and -1500 kPa.
The source supplies separate Northern and Southern Karnataka regressions, including clay-only alternatives.
Percentages and regression coefficients do not by themselves establish gravimetric or volumetric water content.
legacy_quantity_policy: The existing legacy gravimetric_water_content identifier is not sufficient evidence to add a measurement descriptor. Existing YAML warnings explicitly preserve the missing mass/volume statement.
required_evidence: A source-linked analytical protocol or documented clarification establishing the water-content denominator, sample preparation and particle-size definitions.
decision: Keep these implemented formulas outside manifest-driven evaluation until the scientific measurement contract is supported; do not infer a denominator from percentages or local benchmark availability.
